task: Increase only Granite's model request timeout to 60 seconds for queued audits.
nonGoals: No frontend, CPU, usage limit, queue configuration, Terra timeout, scoring rubric, or unrelated service changes. No live inference in CI.

outcomes.description: Granite accepts an elapsed 59.5-second response and aborts at 60 seconds, while Terra keeps 30 seconds.
Granite job ownership covers the longer model request and existing cache entries do not mask a rerun.
outcomes.evidence: Prepared consumer lease and provider policy checks.

process.description: Complete a separately planned PR, obtain independent review and preserve source-bound checks before authorized deployment.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluation, review and explicit rollout verification.

styleEfficiency.description: Use the existing model timer, provider selector and prepared policy without adding a concurrent deadline.

exitTest.reason: The model duration, lease duration and cache namespace change. The checkpoint ownership and continuation protocols stay intact.

context: The queue passed the prior 30-second Worker background window. Its 11th Granite call timed out under the model's separate 30-second timer.
